title: Have Breakfast & Have Lunch
situation: Meals around a morning shift at the airport.
objective: Use have breakfast and have lunch to talk about your daily meals at work.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I have breakfast at home before my morning shift.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya sarapan di rumah sebelum shift pagi.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: On busy days, I only have a quick breakfast and a glass of water.
dialogue.indonesian: Pada hari sibuk, saya hanya sarapan cepat dan segelas air.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: When the morning is busy, I have lunch a little late.
dialogue.indonesian: Ketika pagi sibuk, saya makan siang agak terlambat.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: My team usually has lunch together in the small room near the office.
dialogue.indonesian: Tim saya biasanya makan siang bersama di ruangan kecil dekat kantor.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: We try to have lunch before the next flight arrives.
dialogue.indonesian: Kami berusaha makan siang sebelum penerbangan berikutnya tiba.

learningNotes: Kata kerja have dipakai untuk makan: have breakfast, have lunch, have dinner.
Untuk orang ketiga tunggal, have berubah menjadi has: my team has lunch.
Jangan menambahkan a sebelum breakfast atau lunch: have breakfast, bukan have a breakfast. Jika ada kata sifat, a boleh dipakai: have a quick breakfast.
